idea-plugin.name: Kiro GUI (ACP)
idea-plugin.description:
A chat window for Kiro inside JetBrains IDEs. The plugin starts your local kiro-cli acp and talks to it over the Agent Client Protocol (JSON-RPC over stdio). The chat is drawn in the IDE's embedded browser when it has one and in a simpler built-in view otherwise.

New here? Read the step-by-step user guide.

Chat

  • Streaming Markdown answers with syntax-coloured code blocks, Copy buttons, and Stop
  • File names in answers are links that open the file (at the line, when one is given)
  • Agent and model pickers, context usage, credits per session and your plan's credits
  • Review file edits as an IDE diff before Kiro applies them; per-tool permission prompts
  • Coloured diff rows with Copy diff / Copy new

Give Kiro context

  • Attach files, selected code (Send to Kiro, Ctrl+Alt+K) and images; paste screenshots with Ctrl+V
  • The open editor file is attached automatically (can be turned off); @ picks project files
  • Long pastes become compact chips instead of filling the input
  • / suggests Kiro's slash commands and your skills

Background jobs and the debugger

  • Kiro can start slow commands (builds, tests, servers) that run in the Run tool window while you keep chatting
  • Kiro can debug your run configurations: breakpoints, conditions, tracepoints, stack, variables, evaluate, step
  • When a command ends or the debugger stops, the plugin tells Kiro once the chat is idle, and Kiro carries on
  • Kiro can run the project's tests with the IDE's test runner and gets a report of what failed, where and why (or the compile errors), then reruns just the failures
  • Kiro can read the console of any run or debug session, yours included (logs, stack traces, server output)
  • A shared Jobs panel (beside or under the chats) lists the running jobs with live output: stop them, open their console, attach output to the chat
  • Choose the shell for Kiro's commands (Git Bash, Command Prompt, WSL, …) if PowerShell is blocked
  • Several chats at once as tabs, with one shared list of sessions and library on the left
  • The tools are served to kiro-cli on 127.0.0.1 only, one secret URL per chat; they can be switched off

Library

  • Sessions in your own folders, grouped by date, with tangents under their parent; reopen, rename, move
  • Skills, steering, specs (with task progress), hooks, agents and MCP servers from .kiro/, with what is switched on and what is off
  • Memories: read and delete what Kiro remembers between chats (kiro-cli 3.x)

Settings

  • kiro-cli path, arguments, environment variables, and the shell to run it through (PowerShell, cmd, bash, WSL)
  • Choice of kiro-cli engine and a start timeout for machines where security software slows kiro-cli down
  • Kiro's memory: off, read only, or read and write (with automatic saving), for the chats this plugin opens
  • Chat font and size; a notification when Kiro finishes a reply

Works with kiro-cli 2.x and 3.x.

Requirements

kiro-cli must be installed and signed in (kiro-cli login). IDE version 2025.1 or newer.

Privacy

The plugin itself sends nothing anywhere. It runs the kiro-cli you installed; what that program sends to Kiro's service is governed by Kiro's own terms and settings. Prompts, attached files and images are passed to kiro-cli on your machine.

This is an independent, community-made plugin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon Web Services or the Kiro team. Kiro is a trademark of its owner.
